name: The Thandol Span
summary: After a blast shatters the northern crossing, Rhag Garmason asks travelers to search for a missing dwarf scout. The Dark Iron clan has attacked Dun Modr, cutting off communication and stranding its defenders without reinforcements. Ol' Rustlocke may hold a clue to the sabotage.

sections.title: Thunder Over the Span
sections.body: A blast has torn through the bridge between Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands. Bronzebeard soldiers at the border were caught in the devastation when Dark Iron dwarves attacked Dun Modr. Their ranks are thinned, and their strongholds are under siege. The survivors, led by Longbraid the Grim, hold their ground against the attackers.

sections.title: A Scout Sent East
sections.body: Longbraid sent veteran scout Ebenezer Rustlocke to inspect the eastern span and see whether a crossing or a northern route remained usable. Days have passed without a report. Dun Modr is under siege, and Rhag Garmason and the garrison have too few soldiers to search the enemy-held rubble for him.

sections.title: Grim Discovery
sections.body: Ol' Rustlocke lies dead among the eastern bridge's debris. His body and the parchment in his fist show that he fell into a Dark Iron ambush while scouting. The Dark Irons still threaten the route between Khaz Modan and Lordaeron.

faq.answer: The Thandol Span crosses the chasm between northern Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands. This dwarven bridge is the main land route from Khaz Modan to the northern lands of Lordaeron.
The Dark Iron dwarf clan attacked the bridge and nearby Dun Modr. They used explosives to sever the span, crippling Alliance travel and catching the Bronzebeard defenders off guard.
Ebenezer Rustlocke was a trusted dwarven scout serving Longbraid the Grim. He was sent to inspect the eastern bridge after the explosion and was killed by Dark Iron forces during his mission.
Rhag Garmason is near Dun Modr, just south of the Thandol Span in northern Wetlands. He helps coordinate the defense while the garrison is cut off from Ironforge.

faq.q: Why hasn't Ironforge sent help to Dun Modr?
faq.answer: The attack came suddenly, the bridge is destroyed, and Dun Modr is under siege. The isolated defenders are too stretched to send couriers or divert troops, so they rely on passing travelers to carry word.

faq.q: What happens after finding Rustlocke's corpse?
faq.answer: Rustlocke's remains hold a parchment showing that Kam Deepfury had explosives stashed just across the span. The parchment begins an effort to destroy the cache before it reaches the remaining bridge, then seek aid from the Alliance camp at Refuge Pointe.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you may see the destruction of the Thandol Span as an insult to dwarven stonework and a blow against Khaz Modan by your hated Dark Iron kin.
As an Alliance member, you know the Thandol Span is the only overland supply route linking Stormwind and Ironforge to Alliance forces in Arathi and Hillsbrad.
